Kan ik met Vantis echt handelen?: Can I actually trade with Vantis?
Ja. Je koopt en verkoopt crypto en aande: Yes. You buy and sell crypto and stocks directly in Vantis, with market, limit, stop and trailing orders and a take-profit and stop-loss on your order.
Nee. Vantis geeft marktinformatie, analy: No. Vantis provides market information, analysis and education, calculated from public data with a fixed method. What you do with it is up to you. Investing involves risk; you can lose some or all of your money.
